newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDIENOS LAUNCHES NEW SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: MEDIENOS LAUNCHES NEW SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Official list company Medienos Plaushas said on Tuesday that it has started the distribution of its new eight million litas share issue.
The company also said it reached agreement in principle with two Lithuanian banks for a 12 million litas seven-year credit.
Director general Petras Chesna said that the shareholders were likely to buy most of the issue.
The main shareholder is Lithuanian Invalda while Estonian Hansapank and Swiss Pictet & Cie also have big stakes.
"Today we have launched our eight million litas new share issue," Chesna told Reuters.
The company decided this year to boost its share capital to 28.1 million litas from 20.1 million litas.
The current shareholders of the company have a right to buy into the new share issue for 30 days.
"I think that the company's shareholders will acquire the whole share issue," Chesna said.
He also said that the eight million litas will be used to upgrade the production lines of the company.
"The upgrading works will cost us 20 million litas and will be finished this year," Chesna said.
